resources.string: Your family’s money in one place: what came in, where it went, and where it’s heading.
Your data lives in one file in your own Google Drive. Net Worth can only see the files it creates or that you pick.
Everyone in the family uses the same file, so you all see the same numbers.
Create a new database file in your Google Drive. You can share it with your partner afterwards.
Pick a database someone shared with you, or one you created on another device.
Create an account for each person
A current account per adult, joint savings, and a savings account per child. You can rename or add accounts later.
